tools.name: check_brand
tools.description: The complete check, and the one to prefer when someone asks whether a brand is free: the name against the U.S. and international trademark registers, the logo if they share one, and the domains and social handles, all resolved into a single verdict of clear, caution or conflict. Returns a link to the full report and to a PDF of it.

classes.description: Nice class numbers, 1 to 45. Call suggest_classes first when the user has not named them.

image.description: The logo, if the user has one. Optional.

tools.name: check_name
tools.description: Scores a proposed brand name against the U.S. federal trademark register and the international Madrid register in the chosen classes, and returns the closest conflicting marks with their similarity, their status, and whether they are still live. Use this when someone asks whether a name is taken, available, or safe to register.

classes.description: Nice class numbers, 1 to 45. Call suggest_classes first when the user has not named them.

tools.name: check_logo
tools.description: Compares a logo image against the registered logos on the U.S. and international registers, three ways: the shape of the image, what the image depicts, and the wording inside it. Each match comes back with a similarity score, how it matched, and whether the registration is still live. Use this when someone shares artwork and asks whether it clashes with an existing mark. The search takes a minute or two, so this returns a job id to read back with get_result.

brand_name.description: The wording in the logo, if known. Sharpens the text match.

tools.name: suggest_classes
tools.description: Maps a plain description of what a business sells onto the Nice classes a trademark filing would need. Call this before check_name whenever the user has not given class numbers.

description.description: What the business sells, in plain words.

tools.name: search_international
tools.description: Searches WIPO Madrid System international registrations by name, showing for each one the countries it was designated in and the countries that refused it. Use this for questions about protecting a name abroad.

tools.name: get_result
tools.description: Returns the current state of a check started earlier, using the job id it gave you. Call it again after a short wait while the status is still running.
